disposition_reason: Spike inference has ordered ground-truth metrics, but the original Figure1 cohort/score and excluded-neuron author models are not recovered for the registered117-file panel. Smoothing/timing and paper-era versus corrected software differ. No numeric paper baseline or same-task win can be inferred from the released-panel controller or a generic pretrained CASCADE checkpoint.

source_paper.title: Spike inference from calcium imaging data acquired with GCaMP8 indicators

evidence.locator: Fig.1; Methods: Spike inference with CASCADE; MLSpike for spike inference; Fig.6
evidence.supports: The paper retrains GC8-pooled and variant-specific models with leave-one-neuron-out evaluation; interneuron and online conditions are distinct.

evidence.locator: Updates2026-10-27; Typical work flow; Quantify expected performance
evidence.supports: Author reports a one-frame timing error affecting some models, distinguishes training configuration and out-of-dataset benchmarking, and links the GCaMP8 paper.
Demonstrates excluding each test neuron from training; config-derived smoothing, correlations/errors/bias and multiple noise levels. It is a current demo, not proof of historical Figure1 equivalence.
Registered released117 pair explicitly states unresolved historical105 Figure1 mapping and no scientific execution/qualification.

target.description: Infer time-resolved spike rates from GCaMP8 calcium fluorescence and compare with simultaneous electrophysiological ground truth, preserving pooled-GC8 and variant-specific source comparisons. Interneuron, single-AP and online analyses are separately identified conditions.

dataset.description: Author CASCADE Ground_truth GCaMP8 variants underlie the task; the existing DS30/31/32 released117-file panel is not yet mapped to the historical Figure1 input version. Current database files alone do not establish original data identity.

cohort.description: Recover the exact historical Figure1 neuron inclusion and biological animal identities. The registration explicitly distinguishes117 released neuron files from unresolved historical105 mapping; pooling interneurons with excitatory neurons would change the task.

split.description: For paper GC8-trained CASCADE, leave the test neuron out of training and retrain each model; pooled-GC8 and variant-specific training pools differ. A new leave-animal-out split can be reported only as an extension.

inputs.description: Calcium ΔF/F traces at the declared frame rate and noise condition; paired electrophysiological spikes supervise permitted training neurons and remain evaluator-only for each heldout neuron. No all-neuron checkpoint may be assumed heldout.

preprocessing.description: Pin resampling, standardized noise generation, temporal window alignment, Gaussian target smoothing and boundary masking to the historical figure. Current configuration-driven demo and2026-10-27 one-frame fix require explicit paper-era/corrected separation.

metric.description: Pearson correlation between inferred and ground-truth spike-rate vectors is the ordered candidate primary endpoint; error and bias remain secondary. Demo uses corrcoef on prepared rates and smoothed normalized absolute error/bias. Historical smoothing/timing and exact figure condition must be recovered before adopting its values.

aggregation.description: Recover the original figure’s neuron/noise/variant aggregation and reported numbers. Demo exports means, medians and quantiles by noise level; this does not identify which summary is the original paper endpoint. Do not pool time bins or noise replicas as independent cells.

comparison.primary_metric: Original-condition per-neuron spike-rate Pearson correlation, with source figure aggregation

published_baseline.description: No authenticated numeric original Figure1 aggregate for the exact registered source condition has been recovered. Published boxplots or p-values are not substituted with guessed scores.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No excluded-neuron author-model rerun. The author LOO procedure supplies a route once original cohort/configurations are recovered; general-release all-neuron weights are not an admissible test baseline.

minimum_effect.rationale: Justify a correlation gain with unchanged temporal precision, rate-error safeguards and biological variability; positive affine rate calibration cannot itself improve Pearson correlation.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired differences over original test neurons with animal/session clustering where applicable and account for model-training and synthetic-noise repetition; no interval rule can be finalized without group identities.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Biological animal where neurons share animals; source test neurons are nested units, not independent time bins or noise replicas.
uncertainty.rationale: The original test exclusion is neuron-level, while biological dependence and historical grouping remain unresolved.

paper_win_requires: Recover original Figure1 identities, score, smoothing, sampling/noise conditions and aggregation before comparing methods.
Use competent pooled and variant-specific author retraining that excludes every test neuron; prove checkpoint membership.
Surpass the published matching result and author rerun with justified effect/uncertainty while preserving full original cohort and declared access/resources.
Report timing-bug corrections separately; no win from changing kernels, adding easier cells, selecting noise levels, using a new split or comparing against pre-GCaMP8 defaults alone.

current_sota.description: No separately source-verified current-SOTA comparison has been established.

episode.improvement_loop: After original-task recovery, iterate inference models on permitted training-neuron data and a declared development route; record all fits and avoid direct final-neuron spike-label feedback.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze training and model membership, source cohort, variants, noise seeds, smoothing/alignment, aggregation, checkpoint/source hashes and resource/access budgets before final scoring.
episode.final_evaluation: Generate paired predictions on the unchanged original LOO tests under protected labels, keeping pooled and variant-specific results separate and preserving all original conditions.
episode.baseline_policy: Keep rounded/source reported scores, exact author rerun scores, generic pretrained models and corrected-code variants distinct. Local released117 evidence alone is calibration/extension evidence.

blocking_issues: Exact published baseline numbers and original aggregate not recovered.
Paper-era smoothing/frame assignment, corrected timing and excluded-neuron model provenance unresolved.
Animal/session dependence and valid final uncertainty rule missing.
No working original-task scientific evaluator qualification, matched author rerun, justified margin or frozen episode budgets.

legacy.notes: Keep the released117 paired controller and transitive runtime recovery materials as calibration infrastructure. The registration already disclaims historical Figure1 equivalence and scientific qualification; no new model/data execution occurs in this overhaul.
